items.sentence: 春天係去旅行嘅好時候。
items.jyutping: ceon1 tin1 hai6 heoi3 leoi5 hang4 ge3 hou2 si4 hau6.
items.meaning: Spring is a good time to travel.

items.sentence: 今年春天我哋去咗公園散步。
items.jyutping: gam1 nin4 ceon1 tin1 ngo5 dei6 heoi3 zo2 gung1 jyun4 saan3 bou6.
items.meaning: This spring we went for a walk in the park.

items.sentence: 夏天好熱。
items.jyutping: haa6 tin1 hou2 jit6
items.meaning: Summer is very hot.

items.sentence: 我夏天鍾意去游水。
items.jyutping: ngo5 haa6 tin1 zung1 ji3 heoi3 jau4 seoi2
items.meaning: I like to go swimming in summer.

items.sentence: 夏天有時會落雨。
items.jyutping: haa6 tin1 jau5 si4 wui5 lok6 jyu5
items.meaning: It sometimes rains in summer.

items.sentence: 我哋約好夏天去旅行。
items.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 joek3 hou2 haa6 tin1 heoi3 leoi5 hang4
items.meaning: We agreed to travel in summer.

items.sentence: 秋天嘅天氣好舒服。
items.jyutping: cau1 tin1 ge3 tin1 hei3 hou2 syu1 fuk6.
items.meaning: The autumn weather is very comfortable.

items.sentence: 我鍾意秋天去行山。
items.jyutping: ngo5 zung1 ji3 cau1 tin1 heoi3 haang4 saan1.
items.meaning: I like to go hiking in autumn.

items.sentence: 秋天落葉落得好靚。
items.jyutping: cau1 tin1 lok6 jip6 lok6 dak1 hou2 leng3.
items.meaning: The leaves fall beautifully in autumn.

items.sentence: 秋天夜晚開始涼快。
items.jyutping: cau1 tin1 je6 maan5 hoi1 ci2 loeng4 faai3.
items.meaning: The autumn nights start to get cool.

items.sentence: 冬天好凍，我要着多件衫。
items.jyutping: dung1 tin1 hou2 dung3, ngo5 jiu3 zoek3 do1 gin6 saam1.
items.meaning: Winter is very cold, I need to wear more clothes.

items.sentence: 冬天我鍾意飲熱茶。
items.jyutping: dung1 tin1 ngo5 zung1 ji3 jam2 jit6 caa4.
items.meaning: I like to drink hot tea in winter.

items.sentence: 冬天嘅時候，好多地方會落雪。
items.jyutping: dung1 tin1 ge3 si4 hau6, hou2 do1 dei6 fong1 wui5 lok6 syut3.
items.meaning: In winter, many places will have snow.

items.sentence: 冬天唔太舒服，我想去旅行。
items.jyutping: dung1 tin1 m4 taai3 syu1 fuk6, ngo5 soeng2 heoi3 leoi5 hang4.
items.meaning: I don’t feel too comfortable in winter, I want to travel.

items.sentence: 最近天氣開始轉涼喇。
items.jyutping: zeoi3 gan6 tin1 hei3 hoi1 ci2 zyun2 leong4 laa3.
items.meaning: The weather has started to get cooler recently.

items.sentence: 你有冇覺得今日轉涼咗？
items.jyutping: nei5 jau5 mou5 gok3 dak1 gam1 jat6 zyun2 leong4 zo2?
items.meaning: Do you feel it's gotten cooler today?

items.sentence: 天氣開始轉涼，要記得著衫。
items.jyutping: tin1 hei3 hoi1 ci2 zyun2 leong4, jiu3 gei3 dak1 zoek3 saam1.
items.meaning: The weather is getting cooler, remember to wear clothes.

items.sentence: 冬天就係咁轉涼。
items.jyutping: dung1 tin1 zau6 hai6 gam2 zyun2 leong4.
items.meaning: That’s how winter gets cooler.

items.sentence: 天氣開始轉暖喇。
items.jyutping: tin1 hei3 hoi1 ci2 zyun2 nyun5 laa3.
items.meaning: The weather is starting to get warmer.

items.sentence: 春天嘅轉暖令啲花開得更靚。
items.jyutping: ceon1 tin1 ge3 zyun2 nyun5 ling6 di1 faa1 hoi1 dak1 gang3 leng3.
items.meaning: The warming of spring makes the flowers bloom more beautifully.

items.sentence: 依家轉暖，唔使着咁多衫。
items.jyutping: ji1 gaa1 zyun2 nyun5, m4 sai2 zoek3 gam3 do1 saam1.
items.meaning: It's getting warmer now, no need to wear so many clothes.

items.sentence: 天氣預報講周末會再轉暖。
items.jyutping: tin1 hei3 jyu6 bou3 gong2 zau1 mut6 wui5 zoi3 zyun2 nyun5.
items.meaning: The weather forecast says it will get warmer again this weekend.

items.sentence: 政府發出颱風警報。
items.jyutping: zing3 fu2 faat3 ceot1 toi4 fung1 ging2 bou3.
items.meaning: The government issued a typhoon warning.

items.sentence: 聽到警報，快啲入室內。
items.jyutping: ting1 dou3 ging2 bou3, faai3 di1 jap6 sat1 noi6.
items.meaning: When you hear the warning, quickly go indoors.

items.sentence: 警報已經結束，可以出街了。
items.jyutping: ging2 bou3 ji5 ging1 git3 zuk1, ho2 ji5 ceot1 gaai1 liu5.
items.meaning: The warning has ended, you can go outside now.

items.sentence: 學校因為警報而停課。
items.jyutping: hok6 haau6 jan1 wai6 ging2 bou3 ji4 ting4 fo3.
items.meaning: The school suspended classes because of the warning.

items.sentence: 政府宣佈掛起三號風球。
items.jyutping: zing3 fu2 syun1 bou3 gwaa3 hei2 saam1 hou6 fung1 kau4。
items.meaning: The government announced hoisting the No. 3 typhoon signal.

items.sentence: 如果掛咗風球，記得留喺屋企。
items.jyutping: jyu4 gwo2 gwaa3 zo2 fung1 kau4, gei3 dak1 lau4 hai2 uk1 kei2。
items.meaning: If the typhoon signal is hoisted, remember to stay at home.

items.sentence: 天文台話今日可能會落風球。
items.jyutping: tin1 man4 toi4 waa6 gam1 jat6 ho2 nang4 wui5 lok6 fung1 kau4。
items.meaning: The observatory said the typhoon signal might be issued today.

items.sentence: 風球一落，地鐵會停咗班。
items.jyutping: fung1 kau4 jat1 lok6, dei6 tit3 wui5 ting4 zo2 baan1。
items.meaning: Once the typhoon signal is hoisted, the MTR will stop running.

items.sentence: 今日政府發出紅色暴雨警告，唔好出街。
items.jyutping: gam1 jat6 zing3 fu2 faat3 ceot1 hung4 sik1 bou6 jyu5 ging2 gou3, m4 hou2 ceot1 gaai1.
items.meaning: Today the government issued a red rain warning, don't go outside.

items.sentence: 紅色暴雨嚟緊，我哋要準備好食物同水。
items.jyutping: hung4 sik1 bou6 jyu5 lai4 gan2, ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zeon2 bei6 hou2 sik6 mat6 tung4 seoi2.
items.meaning: The red rain warning is coming, we need to prepare food and water.

items.sentence: 學校因紅色暴雨要提早放學。
items.jyutping: hok6 haau6 jan1 hung4 sik1 bou6 jyu5 jiu3 tai4 zou2 fong3 hok6.
items.meaning: Because of the red rain warning, schools have to finish early.

items.sentence: 紅色暴雨警告話今日會落大雨。
items.jyutping: hung4 sik1 bou6 jyu5 ging2 gou3 waa6 gam1 jat6 wui5 lok6 daai6 jyu5.
items.meaning: The red rain warning says there will be heavy rain today.

items.sentence: 政府已經發出黑色暴雨警告。
items.jyutping: zing3 fu2 ji5 ging1 faat3 ceot1 hak1 sik1 bou6 jyu5 ging2 gou3.
items.meaning: The government has issued a black rain warning.

items.sentence: 黑色暴雨期間小心落雨同交通。
items.jyutping: hak1 sik1 bou6 jyu5 kei4 gaan1 siu2 sam1 lok6 jyu5 tung4 gaau1 tung1.
items.meaning: Be careful of rain and traffic during the black rain warning period.

items.sentence: 我哋收到黑色暴雨警告，要準備好防水措施。
items.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 sau1 dou3 hak1 sik1 bou6 jyu5 ging2 gou3, jiu3 zyun2 bei6 hou2 fong4 seoi2 cou3 si1.
items.meaning: We received a black rain warning and need to prepare waterproof measures.

items.sentence: 今次黑色暴雨好大，出街記得帶遮。
items.jyutping: gam1 ci3 hak1 sik1 bou6 jyu5 hou2 daai6, ceot1 gaai1 gei3 dak1 daai3 ze1.
items.meaning: The black rain warning is very heavy this time, remember to bring an umbrella when going out.

items.sentence: 我哋見到一條好靚嘅彩虹。
items.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gin3 dou3 jat1 tiu4 hou2 leng3 ge3 coi2 hung4.
items.meaning: We saw a very beautiful rainbow.

items.sentence: 落雨之後出現咗彩虹。
items.jyutping: lok6 jyu5 zi1 hau6 ceot1 jin2 zo2 coi2 hung4.
items.meaning: A rainbow appeared after the rain.

items.sentence: 彩虹有好多顏色，好靚。
items.jyutping: coi2 hung4 jau5 hou2 do1 ngaan4 sik1, hou2 leng3.
items.meaning: The rainbow has many colors, very pretty.

items.sentence: 小朋友見到彩虹會好開心。
items.jyutping: siu2 pang4 jau5 gin3 dou3 coi2 hung4 wui5 hou2 hoi1 sam1.
items.meaning: Children feel very happy when they see a rainbow.

items.sentence: 今朝地上有好多霜。
items.jyutping: gam1 ziu1 dei6 soeng6 jau5 hou2 do1 soeng1.
items.meaning: There was a lot of frost on the ground this morning.

items.sentence: 冬天凍到有霜出現。
items.jyutping: dung1 tin1 dung3 dou3 jau5 soeng1 ceot1 jin6.
items.meaning: Frost appears when it gets really cold in winter.

items.sentence: 小心地面霜滑！
items.jyutping: siu2 sam1 dei6 min6 soeng1 waat6!
items.meaning: Be careful, the frost on the ground is slippery!

items.sentence: 今晚可能會有霜降。
items.jyutping: gam1 maan5 ho2 nang4 wui5 jau5 soeng1 gong3.
items.meaning: There might be frost tonight.
